name: Giant Panda National Park
tagline: Giant Panda National Park — Wolong visitor slice; wild pandas never promised.

practical.ticket_note: Check current Wolong / park access; some areas need permits.
practical.transit_note: Sichuan mountain roads; plan a car or tour day from Chengdu.
